**ECON 101**

Students choosing the Global Political Economy and Economic Development concentration should take ECON 101.


**Concentration Courses**

Concentration options are labeled as follows:

A - Global Political Economy and Economic Development (GPED)

B - Global Environment, Health, and Natural Resources (GEHN)

C - Global Institutions and Society (GLIS)

D - International Politics, Peace, and Security (IPPS)
